jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description Our Global Studies Undergraduate Programme nurtures future global leaders by cultivating a global mindset. It is designed to respond to the increasing mobility of talent and integration of national markets, and to meet the rapidly rising demand for leaders who can negotiate international relations and geopolitics, analyse interconnected worldwide economic and financial linkage, and react to global environmental and health challenges (e.g. climate change, pollution, pandemic). The Programme is designed for students who: are interested in global issues want to equip themselves with a global and cosmopolitan vision want to develop analytical and practical skills to help them think globally and act locally want to prepare themselves for careers with an international orientation There are five elective clusters in the programme: Global Media and Popular Culture Global Economy World Politics Planetary Health Quantitative Methods in Global Studies The programme contains the following major components: Faculty Package Resident study overseas Foreign language courses Student-designed interdisciplinary concentration area Internship Capstone courses GLSD students are trained to work in the public and private sectors, including: Government; Multinational Corporations; Global Organizations; Non-profit Organizations; and Education Institutions. Graduates can also pursue postgraduate studies in the area of globalization and related fields.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Interdisciplinary Curriculum Nurturing Future Global Leaders Our Global Studies (GLSD) undergraduate programme nurtures future global leaders by cultivating a global mindset. It is designed to respond to the increased mobility of talents and the integration of national markets, and to meet the rapidly rising demand for leader who can negotiate international relations and geopolitics, analyze interconnected worldwide economic and financial linkage, and react to global environmental and health challenges (e.g. climate change, pollution and pandemics). The programme is designed for students who: are interested in global issues; want to equip themselves with a global and cosmopolitan vision; want to develop analytical and practical skills to help them think globally and act locally; and want to prepare themselves for careers with an international orientation Students can design their own concentration area and build their expertise in this area by choosing a mix of the interdisciplinary courses from the following elective clusters: Global Media and Popular Culture Global Economy World Politics Planetary Health Quantitative Methods in Global Studies Diverse Experiential Learning Activities GLSD students take part in various experiential learning activities to deepen their knowledge of diverse academic disciplines: Faculty Package Resident study overseas Foreign language courses Student-designed interdisciplinary concentration area Internship Capstone courses

curriculum.title: Curriculum Overview
content: The Global Studies (GLSD) programme at CUHK is an interdisciplinary undergraduate programme designed to nurture future global leaders by cultivating a global mindset. It responds to the increasing mobility of talent and integration of national markets, and meets the demand for leaders who can negotiate international relations, analyse global economic linkages, and address global environmental and health challenges.
The programme is designed for students who:
- Want to equip themselves with a global and cosmopolitan vision
- Want to develop analytical and practical skills to think globally and act locally
- Want to prepare for careers with an international orientation

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK's main campus is located in Shatin, offering a spacious and scenic environment with a unique college system that fosters a close-knit community.
Students benefit from a vibrant campus life with numerous student societies, cultural events, and sports facilities.
The programme includes a resident study overseas component, allowing students to gain international exposure.
Foreign language courses and internships further enrich the learning experience.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: CUHK offers a range of entrance scholarships based on academic merit for local and non-local students.
Local JUPAS students may be eligible for admission scholarships that cover tuition fees and living expenses.
Other major scholarships include the Hong Kong Government's Targeted Scholarship and Financial Support (TSFS) and the Non-local Student Scholarship (NLSPS).

tips.title: Ace Sir's Global Studies Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: Aim for a Best 5 score of at least 26.5 (median) to be competitive. With English weighted ×1.5, a strong English grade (5 or above) significantly boosts your total.
Place JS4892 in Band A to maximize your chance. In 2025, all 17 offers went to Band A applicants.
Choose electives that align with global studies themes (e.g., Economics, Geography, History, or a language). Two electives at Level 3 are required, but higher grades improve your score.
Since English is weighted 1.5x, aim for Level 5 or above. Practice academic reading and writing on global issues.

Read international news, follow global affairs, and develop opinions on topics like climate change, geopolitics, and international economics. This will help in interviews (if any) and in your personal statement.
The programme includes a Faculty Package with foundational courses. Prepare to engage with interdisciplinary content early.
The resident study overseas component is a highlight. Start researching exchange programmes and language requirements now.
Participate in Model United Nations, debate clubs, or volunteer with NGOs. These activities demonstrate global mindset and leadership.
Since there is no interview, your DSE results and JUPAS choices are the sole criteria. Focus entirely on achieving the highest possible scores.

curriculum.title: 課程概覽
content: 全球研究（GLSD）本科課程是一個跨學科課程，旨在培養具備全球視野的未來領袖。課程回應人才流動性增加和國家市場整合的趨勢，滿足對能夠處理國際關係、分析全球經濟聯繫及應對全球環境與健康挑戰的領袖的迫切需求。
- 希望裝備全球與國際視野
- 希望發展分析與實踐技能，以全球思考、本地行動
- 希望為國際導向的職業做好準備
- 學生自訂跨學科專修領域

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 香港中文大學主校園位於沙田，環境寬敞優美，獨有的書院制度營造緊密的社群氛圍。
學生可參與眾多學生社團、文化活動及體育設施，校園生活豐富多彩。
課程包括海外駐校學習部分，讓學生獲得國際經驗。
外語課程和實習進一步豐富學習體驗。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與資助
content: 香港中文大學為本地及非本地學生提供多項基於學術成績的入學獎學金。
本地 JUPAS 學生可申請涵蓋學費及生活費的入學獎學金。
其他主要獎學金包括香港政府的專上學生資助計劃（TSFS）及非本地學生獎學金（NLSPS）。

tips.title: Ace Sir 的全球研究策略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: 以最佳 5 科至少 26.5 分（中位數）為目標。英國語文比重 ×1.5，取得 5 級或以上可大幅提升總分。
將 JS4892 放在 Band A 以最大化機會。2025 年所有 17 個錄取名額均來自 Band A 申請者。
選擇與全球研究相關的選修科（如經濟、地理、歷史或語言）。兩門選修需達第 3 級，但更高分數有助提升總分。
由於英語比重 1.5 倍，目標取得第 5 級或以上。多練習全球議題的學術閱讀與寫作。
閱讀國際新聞，關注全球事務，並對氣候變化、地緣政治、國際經濟等議題形成見解。這有助於個人陳述及面試（如有）。
課程包含學院套裝基礎科目，提早準備跨學科內容的學習。
海外駐校學習是課程亮點，現在就開始研究交換計劃及語言要求。
參與模擬聯合國、辯論社或非政府組織義工活動，展現全球視野與領導力。
由於無需面試，DSE 成績及 JUPAS 選擇是唯一標準。全力爭取最高分數。
